hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: api
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: the url for the api calls

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/bin/bash
aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl --role-session-name "s3-test" >assume-role-output.txt
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(grep AccessKeyId assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g") export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(grep SecretAccessKey assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g") export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(grep SessionToken assume-role-output.txt | cut -d ':' -f 2 | sed "s/[ ,\"]//g") mkdir ${datasetId} aws s3 cp s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/newDictionary/${datasetId}/ ./${datasetId}/ --recursive
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID unset AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
#dataset insert csvcut -z 10000000 -d 'φ' -c 1,2,3,4 ${datasetId}/datasets.csv | csvformat -z 10000000 -D 'φ' -U3 -Q🐍 >${datasetId}/dataset_table.csv IFS='φ' #core dataset entry while read datasetRef fullName abv desc; do if [[ ${datasetRef} != 'ref' ]]; then echo "Creating Dataset" #create dataset entry curl --retry 5 --max-time 10 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 0 --show-error --silent --request PUT \ --data-urlencode "datasetRef=${datasetRef}" --data-urlencode "abv=${abv}" \ --data-urlencode "fullName=${fullName}" --data-urlencode "desc=${desc}" ${api}/dataset \ || { echo 'dataset curl failed' ; exit 255;} fi done <${datasetId}/dataset_table.csv
#dataset meta entry echo "Creating Dataset Meta" csvcut -z 10000000 -d 'φ' -c 1,5- ${datasetId}/datasets.csv | csvformat -z 10000000 -D 'φ' -U3 -Q🐍 >${datasetId}/dataset_meta_table.csv export columncount=$(csvcut -d 'φ' -z 10000000 -n ${datasetId}/dataset_meta_table.csv | wc -l) for ((i = 2; i < ${columncount} + 1; i++)); do keyname=$(csvcut -d 'φ' -z 10000000 -c ${i} ${datasetId}/dataset_meta_table.csv | csvcut -d 'φ' -z 10000000 -n | cut -c6-) echo $keyname csvcut -z 10000000 -d 'φ' -c 1,${i} ${datasetId}/dataset_meta_table.csv | csvformat -z 10000000 -D 'φ' >${datasetId}/dataset_meta_column.csv while read datasetRef values; do if [[ ${datasetRef} != 'ref' ]] && [[ ! -z ${values} ]]; then curl --retry 5 --max-time 10 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 0 --show-error --silent --request PUT \ --data-urlencode "datasetRef=${datasetRef}" --data-urlencode "key=${keyname}" \ --data-urlencode "values=${values}" ${api}/dataset/metadata || { echo 'dataset meta curl failed' ; exit 255; } fi done <${datasetId}/dataset_meta_column.csv done
#consents insert echo "Creating Consents" while read datasetRef consentCode description participantCount variableCount sampleCount authz; do echo datasetRef $datasetRef echo description $description echo participantCount $participantCount if [[ ${datasetRef} != 'datasetRef' ]]; then curl --retry 5 --max-time 10 --retry-connrefused --retry-delay 0 --show-error --silent --request PUT \ --data-urlencode "datasetRef=${datasetRef}" --data-urlencode "consentCode=${consentCode}" \ --data-urlencode "description=${description}" --data-urlencode "authz=${authz}" \ --data-urlencode "participantCount=${participantCount}" --data-urlencode "variableCount=${variableCount}" \ --data-urlencode "sampleCount=${sampleCount}" \ ${api}/consent || { echo 'consent curl failed' ; exit 255; } fi done <${datasetId}/consents.csv
#concept insert echo "Creating Concepts" echo "dataset_ref","name","display","concept_type","concept_path","parent_concept_path","values","description","stigmatized" > ${datasetId}/concept_table.csv csvformat -d 'φ' -u3 -q🐍 -z 10000000 -E ${datasetId}/concepts.csv | grep -v 'global_variables' >>${datasetId}/concept_table.csv echo "Concept line count for ${datasetId} = " $(wc -l < ${datasetId}/concept_table.csv) if [[ $(wc -l < ${datasetId}/concept_table.csv) -gt 50000 ]]; then echo "breaking concept_table up into 50k increments" i=1 line1=2 while [[ $line1 -lt $(wc -l < ${datasetId}/concept_table.csv) ]]; do line2=$(($line1+50000))
if [[ $line2 -gt $(wc -l < ${datasetId}/concept_table.csv) ]]; then line2=`wc -l < ${datasetId}/concept_table.csv` fi echo starting $dataset line1 $line1 through line2 $line2 head -n 1 ${datasetId}/concept_table.csv > ${datasetId}/concept_table_$i.csv sed -n "${line1},${line2}p" ${datasetId}/concept_table.csv >> ${datasetId}/concept_table_$i.csv curl --no-progress-meter --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-binary @"${datasetId}/concept_table_$i.csv" "${api}/concept/csv?datasetRef=${datasetId}"
i=$(($i+1)) line1=$line2 done else
curl --fail --no-progress-meter --request PUT --header 'Content-Type: text/plain' \ --data-binary @"${datasetId}/concept_table.csv" "${api}/concept/csv?datasetRef=${datasetId}" || exit 255 fi
